nodes.long_description:
Roll, Match, and Merge Your Way to Victory!

Experience a fresh and immersive take on the classic merge puzzle genre with Ultimate Dice Merge: Brain Puzzle. Designed for Meta Horizon, this game combines the satisfaction of tactile dice mechanics with deep strategic gameplay. In a beautifully rendered virtual space, your goal is to place dice onto the grid, merge matching numbers, and prevent the board from filling up.

Why You Will Love It:

Strategic Dice Mechanics: Rotate dice before placing them to find the perfect fit. Match three or more of the same number to merge them into a higher value.

The Magic Dice: Merge the highest-value dice to unlock the "Magic Dice"—a powerful tool that clears surrounding blocks and boosts your score.

Immersive VR Interaction: Use your controllers to intuitively grab, rotate, and snap dice onto the 3D grid with smooth, satisfying physics.

Brain-Training Fun: Perfect for sharpening your logic and spatial awareness. Every move counts, and a single clever placement can trigger a massive chain reaction!

Stress-Free Environment: Enjoy a clean, minimalist aesthetic and a zen-like atmosphere that allows you to focus entirely on your next strategic move.

Whether you are looking for a quick mental workout or a long, relaxing puzzle session, this game offers endless hours of addictive fun. Grab your headset and start merging!
nodes.short_description: The ultimate 3D dice-merging challenge! Step into Ultimate Dice Merge: Brain Puzzle, a relaxing yet strategic VR experience where you match and merge colorful dice to clear the board. Use your logic to rotate, place, and combine three or more identical dice to create powerful combos. Can you outsmart the grid and achieve the highest score?

nodes.long_description: Łącz kostki i wygrywaj! Poznaj Ultimate Dice Merge w wersji VR. Cechy: Strategiczne układanie, Magiczna Kostka czyszcząca pole oraz wciągająca interakcja 3D.
nodes.short_description: Ostateczne wyzwanie łączenia kostek 3D! Łącz kolorowe kostki, aby oczyścić planszę w tej relaksującej i strategicznej grze VR.
